title: Correct OM length
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final numerical answer for part (1) must be 0.4 m (or equivalent).

title: Correct N specific charge
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final numerical answer for part (2) must be 4.4 × 10⁶ C/kg (or equivalent).

title: Lorentz force application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the formula r = mv/(qB) to relate radius, velocity, magnetic field, and specific charge.

title: Geometry of trajectory
description: Important Criteria: The solution must recognize that the distance OM is the diameter of the circular path, equal to twice the radius.

title: Proportional reasoning for ON
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the given ratio ON = 1.1 × OM to find the new radius and thus the new specific charge.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (meters, Tesla, C/kg) in calculations.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the radius as the distance OM, or confuses diameter with radius.

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student makes an error in solving for the specific charge, such as inverting the ratio or misapplying the formula.
